meta.title: Protection
meta.description: Keep all the danger outside and all the hope within.

units.rawText: That's going to suck. We left all the fighters behind to cover us. I'm the only one who can fight now...

units.rawText: This area is where we meet and deal with the Traders. Hannah usually takes care of that, and she has never allowed me to come near here.
units.displayText: This area is where we meet and deal with the Traders. Hannah usually takes care of that, and she has never allowed me to come near here.

units.displayText: The Traders... The Traders—Ah! I've got it!

spans.text: The Traders... The Traders—Ah! I've got it!

units.rawText: This is Riko's secret train station. We Traders need to balance the operands across each sector, so we do a lot of work.
units.displayText: This is Riko's secret train station. We Traders need to balance the operands across each sector, so we do a lot of work.

spans.text: This is Riko's secret train station. We Traders need to balance the operands across each sector, so we do a lot of work.

units.rawText: If the sectors didn't provide special train lines for the Traders, then just walking through Rossum alone would exhaust Riko.
units.displayText: If the sectors didn't provide special train lines for the Traders, then just walking through Rossum alone would exhaust Riko.

spans.text: If the sectors didn't provide special train lines for the Traders, then just walking through Rossum alone would exhaust Riko.

units.rawText: That fox brought us here before!
units.displayText: That fox brought us here before!

spans.text: That fox brought us here before!

units.rawText: Which fox? Do you mean the Traders?
units.displayText: Which fox? Do you mean the Traders?

spans.text: Which fox? Do you mean the Traders?

units.rawText: Yup, that's right, and this is definitely the place. I was wondering why it seemed so familiar.
units.displayText: Yup, that's right, and this is definitely the place. I was wondering why it seemed so familiar.

spans.text: Yup, that's right, and this is definitely the place. I was wondering why it seemed so familiar.

units.rawText: There's an entrance to the Trader station nearby! Once we take it, we can proceed underground to the Data Center!

spans.text: There's an entrance to the Trader station nearby! Once we take it, we can proceed underground to the Data Center!

units.displayText: Let's go! Down the hatch!

spans.text: Let's go! Down the hatch!

units.displayText: The two of them squirm into the messy pile of rubble.

units.displayText: Less than half a minute later, a horde of writhing black shapes arrives on top of the rubble.

units.displayText: Hsss.

spans.text: Hsss.

units.displayText: They... vanished here...? Why...?

spans.text: They... vanished here...? Why...?

units.displayText: Hsss!

units.rawText: In the Rossum Sector, near the Data Center.
units.displayText: In the Rossum Sector, near the Data Center.

units.rawText: Holy cow, that was one hell of a ride. Good thing we had a direct line...
units.displayText: Holy cow, that was one hell of a ride. Good thing we had a direct line...

spans.text: Holy cow, that was one hell of a ride. Good thing we had a direct line...

units.rawText: Anyway, we're here. Are you alright, Turing?
units.displayText: Anyway, we're here. Are you alright, Turing?

spans.text: Anyway, we're here. Are you alright, Turing?

units.rawText: Your driving skills were... quite impressive... I need to sort out my neural cloud data...
units.displayText: Your driving skills were... quite impressive... I need to sort out my neural cloud data...

spans.text: Your driving skills were... quite impressive... I need to sort out my neural cloud data...

units.rawText: Eh, it couldn't be helped. Those lunatics punched straight through the ground, so I had to take the wheel.

spans.text: Eh, it couldn't be helped. Those lunatics punched straight through the ground, so I had to take the wheel.

units.rawText: They might catch up anytime. How are you, can you walk?
units.displayText: They might catch up anytime. How are you, can you walk?

units.displayText: Turing gives Sol her hand as she pants.

spans.text: Sol catches her drift and scoops her into her arms before running over to the front door of the Data Center.

units.displayText: Sol puts Turing down in front of the Data Center and looks around at the mostly intact surroundings.

spans.text: Sol puts Turing down in front of the Data Center and looks around at the mostly intact surroundings.

units.rawText: So this is... the Data Center...
units.displayText: So this is... the Data Center...

spans.text: So this is... the Data Center...

units.rawText: Is this your first time here?
units.displayText: Is this your first time here?

spans.text: Is this your first time here?

units.rawText: Yes. Hannah moved all the tasks being performed here to the Admin Center. It's been half-shutdown before today. Only Hannah was allowed to come and go.
units.displayText: Yes. Hannah moved all the tasks being performed here to the Admin Center. It's been half-shutdown before today. Only Hannah was allowed to come and go.

units.displayText: Half-shutdown, huh...

spans.text: Half-shutdown, huh...

units.rawText: Well, I can see why. After all, she probably doesn't want to remember what happened here.
units.displayText: Well, I can see why. After all, she probably doesn't want to remember what happened here.

units.rawText: [Authentication complete. Welcome to the Data Center, Administrator Turing, the Oasis Helper Sol.]
units.displayText: [Authentication complete. Welcome to the Data Center, Administrator Turing, the Oasis Helper Sol.]

spans.text: [Authentication complete. Welcome to the Data Center, Administrator Turing, the Oasis Helper Sol.]

units.displayText: ...Huh? Me, an administrator?

spans.text: ...Huh? Me, an administrator?

units.displayText: Sol is wondering whether she should enlighten Turing, but then she hears a sound from behind them.

spans.text: Sol is wondering whether she should enlighten Turing, but then she hears a sound from behind them.

units.rawText: —Get down!
units.displayText: —Get down!

units.rawText: Boom!
units.displayText: Boom!

spans.text: Boom!

units.displayText: Purple shellfire suddenly washes over them. Sol throws herself forward and shoves Turing into the main hall while she is knocked to the ground by the shockwave.

spans.text: Purple shellfire suddenly washes over them. Sol throws herself forward and shoves Turing into the main hall while she is knocked to the ground by the shockwave.

units.rawText: Miss Sol!
units.displayText: Miss Sol!

spans.text: Miss Sol!

units.rawText: (Coughs) They're just too damn fast...
units.displayText: (Coughs) They're just too damn fast...

spans.text: (Coughs) They're just too damn fast...

units.rawText: Sol quickly gets up and reaches a nearby lever in a few steps, which she pulls. The Data Center immediately glows with red light, and the main door seals shut.
units.displayText: Sol quickly gets up and reaches a nearby lever in a few steps, which she pulls. The Data Center immediately glows with red light, and the main door seals shut.

units.rawText: I didn't know something like this existed...
units.displayText: I didn't know something like this existed...

spans.text: I didn't know something like this existed...

units.rawText: Good thing I came here before.
units.displayText: Good thing I came here before.

spans.text: Good thing I came here before.

units.rawText: This ought to hold them for a bit. Come on, let's go decompress the—

spans.text: This ought to hold them for a bit. Come on, let's go decompress the—

units.rawText: Sol draws her sword, but the weapon falls to the ground instead. Light purple operands ooze from her shoulder.
units.displayText: Sol draws her sword, but the weapon falls to the ground instead. Light purple operands ooze from her shoulder.

spans.text: Sol draws her sword, but the weapon falls to the ground instead. Light purple operands ooze from her shoulder.

units.rawText: Miss Sol! You're hurt!
units.displayText: Miss Sol! You're hurt!

spans.text: Miss Sol! You're hurt!

units.rawText: Huh? Am I? Well damn. I wouldn't have known if you hadn't told me.
units.displayText: Huh? Am I? Well damn. I wouldn't have known if you hadn't told me.

spans.text: Huh? Am I? Well damn. I wouldn't have known if you hadn't told me.

units.rawText: Aw, it's just a small thing, hurry up and decompress the operands!
units.displayText: Aw, it's just a small thing, hurry up and decompress the operands!

spans.text: Aw, it's just a small thing, hurry up and decompress the operands!

units.rawText: No, you'll bleed operands if I don't attend to you.
units.displayText: No, you'll bleed operands if I don't attend to you.

spans.text: No, you'll bleed operands if I don't attend to you.

units.rawText: Stay still and don't move. Let me treat you.
units.displayText: Stay still and don't move. Let me treat you.

spans.text: Stay still and don't move. Let me treat you.

units.rawText: Huh? Turing?
units.displayText: Huh? Turing?

spans.text: Huh? Turing?

units.rawText: It'll be done soon... I learned how to heal injuries, too...
units.displayText: It'll be done soon... I learned how to heal injuries, too...

spans.text: It'll be done soon... I learned how to heal injuries, too...

units.rawText: Turing goes to Sol's side and goes down on one knee before placing her palms on Sol's shoulders and focusing on infusing healing operands into her.
units.displayText: Turing goes to Sol's side and goes down on one knee before placing her palms on Sol's shoulders and focusing on infusing healing operands into her.

spans.text: Turing goes to Sol's side and goes down on one knee before placing her palms on Sol's shoulders and focusing on infusing healing operands into her.

units.rawText: ...It feels kind of hot... I can feel the operands flowing...
units.displayText: ...It feels kind of hot... I can feel the operands flowing...

spans.text: ...It feels kind of hot... I can feel the operands flowing...

units.rawText: Please don't move and wait a while longer. The recovery will take a bit more time.
units.displayText: Please don't move and wait a while longer. The recovery will take a bit more time.

spans.text: Please don't move and wait a while longer. The recovery will take a bit more time.

units.rawText: Well done, Turing! Your skills are on the level of a professional healing agent!
units.displayText: Well done, Turing! Your skills are on the level of a professional healing agent!

spans.text: Well done, Turing! Your skills are on the level of a professional healing agent!

units.rawText: The classes that Hannah had me take included lessons on how to repair agents, though I never had the chance to put them to use.
units.displayText: The classes that Hannah had me take included lessons on how to repair agents, though I never had the chance to put them to use.

spans.text: The classes that Hannah had me take included lessons on how to repair agents, though I never had the chance to put them to use.

units.rawText: That's strange. Why am I even doing this? According to my priorities, I shouldn't be spending time on this...
units.displayText: That's strange. Why am I even doing this? According to my priorities, I shouldn't be spending time on this...

spans.text: That's strange. Why am I even doing this? According to my priorities, I shouldn't be spending time on this...

units.rawText: Yeah, based on your priorities, you should have left me behind and decompressed the operands.
units.displayText: Yeah, based on your priorities, you should have left me behind and decompressed the operands.

spans.text: Yeah, based on your priorities, you should have left me behind and decompressed the operands.

units.rawText: But I keep feeling that I can't do that... I don't know which way of thinking is right...
units.displayText: But I keep feeling that I can't do that... I don't know which way of thinking is right...

spans.text: But I keep feeling that I can't do that... I don't know which way of thinking is right...

units.rawText: That's not important. You're healing me now, aren't you? So rather than considering priorities, you've already made your choice.
units.displayText: That's not important. You're healing me now, aren't you? So rather than considering priorities, you've already made your choice.

spans.text: That's not important. You're healing me now, aren't you? So rather than considering priorities, you've already made your choice.

units.rawText: But you got hurt saving me, so it's only right that I should help you, isn't that so?
units.displayText: But you got hurt saving me, so it's only right that I should help you, isn't that so?

spans.text: But you got hurt saving me, so it's only right that I should help you, isn't that so?

units.rawText: Aw, it's not that complicated. Protecting your friends is just common sense, right? Haven't we been helping each other out along the way here?
units.displayText: Aw, it's not that complicated. Protecting your friends is just common sense, right? Haven't we been helping each other out along the way here?

spans.text: Aw, it's not that complicated. Protecting your friends is just common sense, right? Haven't we been helping each other out along the way here?

units.rawText: I mean, Hannah blew up the Admin Center earlier to save us, right?
units.displayText: I mean, Hannah blew up the Admin Center earlier to save us, right?

spans.text: I mean, Hannah blew up the Admin Center earlier to save us, right?

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, I don't understand why you took such a risk to save me and why Hannah had to sacrifice the entire Admin Center for us.
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, I don't understand why you took such a risk to save me and why Hannah had to sacrifice the entire Admin Center for us.

spans.text: Frankly speaking, I don't understand why you took such a risk to save me and why Hannah had to sacrifice the entire Admin Center for us.

units.rawText: Isn't that like how you chose to heal me now?
units.displayText: Isn't that like how you chose to heal me now?

spans.text: Isn't that like how you chose to heal me now?

units.rawText: No, it's not like that. I'm just an ordinary agent in the sector, while you're a guest in Rossum. You represent the friendly relationship between Rossum and the Oasis. Our respective values are different.
units.displayText: No, it's not like that. I'm just an ordinary agent in the sector, while you're a guest in Rossum. You represent the friendly relationship between Rossum and the Oasis. Our respective values are different.

spans.text: No, it's not like that. I'm just an ordinary agent in the sector, while you're a guest in Rossum. You represent the friendly relationship between Rossum and the Oasis. Our respective values are different.

units.rawText: Ahhhh, who cares about worth or whatever? Did you heal me because you were worried that the partnership with the Oasis would be ruined if you didn't?
units.displayText: Ahhhh, who cares about worth or whatever? Did you heal me because you were worried that the partnership with the Oasis would be ruined if you didn't?

spans.text: Ahhhh, who cares about worth or whatever? Did you heal me because you were worried that the partnership with the Oasis would be ruined if you didn't?

units.rawText: I am...? I don't quite get it...
units.displayText: I am...? I don't quite get it...

spans.text: I am...? I don't quite get it...

units.rawText: Then remember how you feel right now. If you run into something you don't understand, just plunge right in and stop for nothing. Who knows? You might figure it out eventually. I mean, that's what I've always done.
units.displayText: Then remember how you feel right now. If you run into something you don't understand, just plunge right in and stop for nothing. Who knows? You might figure it out eventually. I mean, that's what I've always done.

spans.text: Then remember how you feel right now. If you run into something you don't understand, just plunge right in and stop for nothing. Who knows? You might figure it out eventually. I mean, that's what I've always done.

units.rawText: How is it? You're pretty much done with the healing, right? My arm is moving much better now.
units.displayText: How is it? You're pretty much done with the healing, right? My arm is moving much better now.

spans.text: How is it? You're pretty much done with the healing, right? My arm is moving much better now.

units.rawText: Yeah, that's pretty much it. Please be careful, Miss Sol.
units.displayText: Yeah, that's pretty much it. Please be careful, Miss Sol.

spans.text: Yeah, that's pretty much it. Please be careful, Miss Sol.

units.rawText: Whew—Okay, I'm fine!
units.displayText: Whew—Okay, I'm fine!

spans.text: Whew—Okay, I'm fine!

units.displayText: Sol jumps up and swings her arms. She seems very refreshed.

spans.text: Sol jumps up and swings her arms. She seems very refreshed.

units.rawText: Thank you, Turing. You transferred a lot of operands to me, so it's my turn to be useful now.
units.displayText: Thank you, Turing. You transferred a lot of operands to me, so it's my turn to be useful now.

spans.text: Thank you, Turing. You transferred a lot of operands to me, so it's my turn to be useful now.

units.rawText: Go decompress the operands and send them out. The quicker, the better.
units.displayText: Go decompress the operands and send them out. The quicker, the better.

spans.text: Go decompress the operands and send them out. The quicker, the better.

units.rawText: Huh? But what about you, Miss Sol?
units.displayText: Huh? But what about you, Miss Sol?

spans.text: Huh? But what about you, Miss Sol?

units.rawText: I may have activated the emergency defense mode, but it won't last for long.
units.displayText: I may have activated the emergency defense mode, but it won't last for long.

units.displayText: Sol draws her blades.

spans.text: Sol draws her blades.

units.rawText: I'll hold the door for you.
units.displayText: I'll hold the door for you.

spans.text: I'll hold the door for you.

units.rawText: But how... There are so many Entropics, how can one person hold them back?
units.displayText: But how... There are so many Entropics, how can one person hold them back?

spans.text: But how... There are so many Entropics, how can one person hold them back?

units.rawText: I'm not going to take them all on by myself, of course. I'll operate the defenses here.
units.displayText: I'm not going to take them all on by myself, of course. I'll operate the defenses here.

spans.text: I'm not going to take them all on by myself, of course. I'll operate the defenses here.

units.rawText: Now stop standing around and go! You can't fight, and I can't operate the systems here, so we've got our work cut out for us. You should have computed the same conclusion too, right?

units.displayText: She smiles bitterly, and then she nods.

spans.text: She smiles bitterly, and then she nods.

units.displayText: ...Yes, I understand. I'll go decompress the operands now.

units.displayText: Just leave it to me!

spans.text: Just leave it to me!

units.rawText: Yup. And if you want to talk about worth, then you're worth more to Hannah than any research data.
